# R154 Experiment Log

## Final Adoption

- Final body/inner baseline kept: `r154_partteacher_toponly_v15_greedyextra_from_r130_headboxfixed_300`
- Final face path kept: `r130_facepostfit_4200c_000050_1000_innerrgb`
- Rule: head stays locked to r130; body experiments after that did not beat r154 overall.

## Structural Decisions

- `stage2_face_fit`, `stage2_part_fit`, `stage2_teacher_bank` are training / postfit logic, not evaluation logic. They were moved out of `evaluation/` into main logic under `src/avatar_gs/cli` and `src/avatar_gs/stage2`.
- `evaluation/stage2_eval` remains the only stage2 evaluation code path.
- Old eval-only experiment outputs under `evaluation/eval_outputs/stage2_face_fit`, `stage2_part_fit`, `stage2_teacher_bank` are disposable once this log exists.

## Hard Lessons

- Face teacher selection by wrong frames poisoned everything. Back-facing or weakly aligned frames created average-face mud.
- Teacher-only / warmup / canonical face tricks can improve worst face frames, but shared-inner face quality still hit a hard ceiling.
- The old so-called top-only route was partially fake before the train-parts bug was fixed. That false comfort cost time.
- Body part postfit fails mainly when base teachers are soft or dirty. Extra teachers are a secondary problem, not the main one.
- Metrics like MAE/SSIM reward smoothing. They will happily tell you a blur is good if the blur is stable.
- The fixed head box originally froze almost all torso gaussians. That hid the real torso problem until the bug was removed.
- Once the torso freeze bug was fixed, torso still got worse. That proved the blocker had moved to teacher quality itself.
